ayahs.arabicText: الٓمّٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَیْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ١ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّاۤ اَتٰىهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِیْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ١ؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِیٍّ وَّ لَا شَفِیْعٍ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

ayahs.arabicText: یُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ یَعْرُجُ اِلَیْهِ فِیْ یَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗۤ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الْغَیْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْۤ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَ بَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّآءٍ مَّهِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ سَوّٰىهُ وَ نَفَخَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِهٖ وَ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْئِدَةَ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِی الْاَرْضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِیْدٍ١ؕ۬ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When we are lost within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِیْ وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Say, "The angel of death will take you who has been entrusted with you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ تَرٰۤى اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ نَاكِسُوْا رُءُوْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ١ؕ رَبَّنَاۤ اَبْصَرْنَا وَ سَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا اِنَّا مُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَاٰتَیْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدٰىهَا وَ لٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّیْ لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذُوْقُوْا بِمَا نَسِیْتُمْ لِقَآءَ یَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا١ۚ اِنَّا نَسِیْنٰكُمْ وَ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا یُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَا الَّذِیْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهَا خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّ سَبَّحُوْا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ هُمْ لَا یَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

ayahs.arabicText: تَتَجَافٰى جُنُوْبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ یَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَّ طَمَعًا١٘ وَّ مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ یُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّاۤ اُخْفِیَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ اَعْیُنٍ١ۚ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا١ؔؕ لَا یَسْتَوٗنَؐ
ayahs.translation: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ الْمَاْوٰى١٘ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ فَسَقُوْا فَمَاْوٰىهُمُ النَّارُ١ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَرَادُوْۤا اَنْ یَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَاۤ اُعِیْدُوْا فِیْهَا وَ قِیْلَ لَهُمْ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَنُذِیْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنٰى دُوْنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا١ؕ اِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَآئِهٖ وَ جَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَۚ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَئِمَّةً یَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْا١ؕ۫ وَ كَانُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا یُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ یَفْصِلُ بَیْنَهُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فِیْمَا كَانُوْا فِیْهِ یَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ یَمْشُوْنَ فِیْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ١ؕ اَفَلَا یَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّا نَسُوْقُ الْمَآءَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا تَاْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَامُهُمْ وَ اَنْفُسُهُمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا یُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا یَنْفَعُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِیْمَانُهُمْ وَ لَا هُمْ یُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَ انْتَظِرْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّنْتَظِرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
